unreachable.title: We could not check your link
unreachable.bannerText: Your link has not been used. Check your connection and try again.

invalid.title: This link cannot be used
invalid.defaultMessage: This link is invalid or has expired.
invalid.bannerText: Nothing has changed on the account, and the old password still works.
invalid.help_one: Reset links work for {{count}} minute and only once, and asking for a new one cancels the old one. Ask for a new link and use it straight away.
invalid.help_other: Reset links work for {{count}} minutes and only once, and asking for a new one cancels the old one. Ask for a new link and use it straight away.

done.title: Password changed
done.text: Sign in to {{email}} with your new password. Every other device was signed out.

form.title: Choose a new password
form.intro: You are setting a new password for {{email}}. The link you opened works once.
form.note: Saving signs you out everywhere else, so anyone using the old password is locked out.

toast.reset: Your password has been reset. Please sign in again.
toast.failed: Could not save your new password. Please try again.
